preconditions.description: The number of words in Amugae's sentence is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each word is non-empty and consists of uppercase and lowercase English letters and digits.
preconditions.description: The words in the sentence are non-empty and contain only the specified characters.

preconditions.expression: The total length of the words does not exceed 10^6.
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all words in the sentence does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: The output is the compressed word after the merging process ends.
postconditions.description: The output is the result of merging the words in the order they appear in the input, removing the longest prefix of each word that coincides with a suffix of the previous word.
